prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: second high-fidelity compositional option for a desktop Thai administrative web app, 1440x1000 landscape
Primary request: Same indexed-evidence-registry visual world for a Thai university planning, budget, project, quarterly disbursement, EdPEx and AUN-QA system, but test a quarter-led command composition.
Composition/framing: a 92px burnt-orange index rail on the left; header is a strong horizontal fiscal register with year and Q1-Q4 tabs plus a five-stage lifecycle rule. The center begins with one wide งานต้องตัดสินใจวันนี้ queue as stacked ledger strips, each strip showing owner, amount, deadline, and next action. Below it, a broad four-quarter budget runway compares planned and actual values using orange rules and direct labels, not a generic chart card. A narrower right column is the selected record docket with progress, evidence, and approval history. Keep all critical content in the first viewport and show the next section beginning at the bottom.
Style/medium: polished production-ready SaaS UI mockup, flat warm-white surfaces, crisp index tabs, ledger rules, minimal borders, sharp corners with only small radii, precise Thai typography, tabular figures.
Color palette: burnt orange #C2410C, orange #EA580C, warm white #FFF9F5, white #FFFFFF, charcoal #292524, restrained green #166534, amber and red for warnings only.
Materials/textures: digital fiscal register, index tab edges, ruled ledger strips, no literal paper texture.
Text: Thai-first fiscal register labels, decision queue, Q1-Q4, budget plan, actual and selected record dossier.
Constraints: accessible contrast, realistic dense sample data, clear labels plus color for state, no logo or institutional seal, no browser chrome.
Avoid: generic metric card row, dashboard mosaic, gradients, glassmorphism, purple or blue branding, huge rounded cards, decorative illustration, dark mode, unlabeled charts.
